from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="End date of the reporting period in YYYY-MM format")
    monetary_funds: float | None = Field(description="Ending balance of monetary funds")
    accounts_receivable: float | None = Field(description="Ending balance of accounts receivable")
    accounts_payable: float | None = Field(description="Ending balance of accounts payable")
    contract_liabilities: float | None = Field(description="Ending balance of contract liabilities")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    reports: list[FinancialMetric]
